raw: [name="Exhausted Viscount"]If you really care about them, really think that they're heroes, a part of Victoria...
speaker: Exhausted Viscount
content: If you really care about them, really think that they're heroes, a part of Victoria...

raw: [name="Exhausted Viscount"]...Think of how many people like them are there in your mother's demesne.

content: ...Think of how many people like them are there in your mother's demesne.

raw: [name="Exhausted Viscount"]If you really want to protect these people, take my advice and seek aid from the Duke of Caster to return to your demesne and take charge.
speaker: Exhausted Viscount
content: If you really want to protect these people, take my advice and seek aid from the Duke of Caster to return to your demesne and take charge.

raw: [name="Exhausted Viscount"]Perhaps you will have to become a Caster vassal... but you'll be able to fulfill your duty.
speaker: Exhausted Viscount
content: Perhaps you will have to become a Caster vassal... but you'll be able to fulfill your duty.

speaker: Delphine
content: I—

raw: [name="Exhausted Viscount"]What are you balking at? Did you fall in love with them just because they fought alongside you? You've stopped loving your own subjects?
speaker: Exhausted Viscount
content: What are you balking at? Did you fall in love with them just because they fought alongside you? You've stopped loving your own subjects?

raw: [name="Exhausted Viscount"]Accept it, Delphine... you and your mother have suffered enough.
speaker: Exhausted Viscount
content: Accept it, Delphine... you and your mother have suffered enough.

raw: [name="Exhausted Viscount"]Accept Duke Caster's proposal, and at least Windermere will be spared from devastation.
speaker: Exhausted Viscount
content: Accept Duke Caster's proposal, and at least Windermere will be spared from devastation.

raw: [name="Exhausted Viscount"]Why do you hesitate? Do you really want to be a vagabond forever, leaving your family, your bloodline and your duty behind?
speaker: Exhausted Viscount
content: Why do you hesitate? Do you really want to be a vagabond forever, leaving your family, your bloodline and your duty behind?

speaker: Delphine
content: ...I understand.

raw: [name="Delphine"]I'm Mother's daughter. You're right, I have a responsibility, not just to my friends, but to the subjects of Windermere as well.
speaker: Delphine
content: I'm Mother's daughter. You're right, I have a responsibility, not just to my friends, but to the subjects of Windermere as well.

speaker: Delphine
content: But...

raw: [name="Delphine"]Why did the Swordguards leave me behind, when I still had such a duty?
speaker: Delphine
content: Why did the Swordguards leave me behind, when I still had such a duty?

raw: [name="Delphine"]If this was a duty glorious beyond all doubt, why do you come to me in such a condition?
speaker: Delphine
content: If this was a duty glorious beyond all doubt, why do you come to me in such a condition?

raw: [name="Delphine"]You're right. If Windermere has fallen under the cloud of conspiracy, then I feel both the obligation and desire to do something about it.
speaker: Delphine
content: You're right. If Windermere has fallen under the cloud of conspiracy, then I feel both the obligation and desire to do something about it.

speaker: Delphine
content: But I...

raw: [name="Siege"]We're with you, Delphine. Say what you want to say.
speaker: Siege
content: We're with you, Delphine. Say what you want to say.

speaker: Siege

raw: [name="Siege"]Do you know what we just went through, madam?

speaker: Exhausted Viscount

speaker: Delphine
content: I'm not going with you.

speaker: Exhausted Viscount
content: You have a duty!

raw: [name="Delphine"]I'm my mother's daughter, comrade to these warriors, and nothing else.
speaker: Delphine
content: I'm my mother's daughter, comrade to these warriors, and nothing else.

raw: [name="Delphine"]Even if I once was... I don't believe it anymore.
speaker: Delphine
content: Even if I once was... I don't believe it anymore.

raw: [name="Delphine"]I stood here for them, so that their lives would no longer be the playthings of people like you, and I'm not going anywhere until I've bled my last.
speaker: Delphine
content: I stood here for them, so that their lives would no longer be the playthings of people like you, and I'm not going anywhere until I've bled my last.

speaker: Delphine

raw: [name="Siege"]I would very much like to. Oh how I wish that this sorry sword I carry had the power to protect my friends, such that none among them would die.

raw: [name="Siege"]She would very much like to. How many times has she cried when no one was watching? Wishing that someone could have saved her mother's life.
